regression_fixtures.contract: Six actual-provider cases for deferred connection/index results, errors, loading completion and unmount; all original nine Web scenarios preserved.

preserved_assertions: Relocated fixtures retain their prior assertions; no snapshot auto-accept or unique assertion removal.

execution.quick: All behavioral scenarios once; sanitizer variants where supported.
execution.full: Same scenarios plus relevant optimization, ABI, role, kernel and supported-core checks.
execution.outputs: Use a fresh evidence directory; existing evidence is never overwritten.

gaps: Physical USB/BLE/split delivery, timing, power and retention require matching production-board evidence.
Host DT accessors are controlled while Zephyr macro utilities and nanopb are real. Owner native/board builds separately validate real DT binding/API compatibility.
native_verification: tests/native_verifier.py: actual exit, registered test completion, raw ordered logs, unchanged snapshots, identical binary repeated three times.
